verdicts.hint: the target's all-features advisory wall (the second cargo-deny step of `cargo xtask ci`) fails on the base, so every bundle's gating C4-ci is red until a separate deny-all-features.toml PR records or clears the advisory (#543; precedent #790/#773; a ready waiver for RUSTSEC-2026-0346/0349 is results/issue_620/base-advisory-waiver.diff). Land it on main, update ../wyrd, then re-run. Checks ../wyrd as checked out, or $WYRD_REPO
